title: Economic Initiative and Diplomacy hints
description: Two decision aids. (1) Economic Initiative, an action card that readies each cultural planet you control, now names those planets in the Action cards menu: the row says "Cultural: ...; readies N of M" and the hover/focus panel lists each planet with its cultural tag and whether it is exhausted (will ready) or already ready. (2) When Diplomacy's secondary asks whether to spend a token to ready two planets, the question (and the ready-planets bar after it) now shows the exhausted planets you could ready with their resource and influence values, and whether Leadership (influence), Technology (resources) and Warfare (resources) have been played this round, so you can decide to wait for those first. The before shots are from the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BZ. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

notes.title: Where the facts come from
notes.text: Display-only engine details: turn menu details.action_card_effects (Economic Initiative's cultural planets) and details.ready_hints on the Diplomacy secondary and on the ready_planet question. Played means the card is exhausted on its holder this round; still to come means a seat holds it unplayed; not in play means nobody holds it. All of that is on the table for every seat. Rules and fingerprints are unchanged.
